instructions: You are one of two independent readers for a public record that scores theories of consciousness. A study counts toward a prediction if that prediction was fixed, by the theory's proponents, in a dated record made before the study's data were collected, whether a publication or a registration. What decides is when the record was fixed, not when it became public. A paper that states a prediction and tests it in the same paper does not count. When the dates or the commitment are unclear, the study is not counted. Read the passages and the dates. Decide: BEFORE (a record by the proponents commits the theory to this prediction and was fixed before the study's data were collected), NOT-BEFORE (it was not), or UNCLEAR. If the study does not say when its data were collected, say how you decided. Answer in JSON: {"verdict": "before"|"not-before"|"unclear", "reason": "two to four plain sentences", "unsure": true|false, "unsure_why": "..."}.

core_claim.quote: Ignition is characterized by the sudden, coherent, and exclusive activation of a subset of workspace neurons coding for the current conscious content, with the remainder of the workspace neurons being inhibited.

source.citation: Mashour GA, Roelfsema P, Changeux J-P, Dehaene S. Conscious processing and the global neuronal workspace hypothesis. Neuron 105(5):776-798, 2020

prediction.statement: Between the onset and offset ignitions, a lasting percept is held in an 'activity-silent' state, not by sustained activity.

first_stated.passage: GNW assumes that all experiences – regardless of their temporal extent – are accompanied by an initial ignition, followed by a decay of signal and maintenance of information in the form of an activity-silent state, with only occasional bursts of reactivation

source.citation: Melloni L, Mudrik L, Pitts M, et al. Preregistration file v1, January 2019: Accelerating research on consciousness: an adversarial collaboration to test contradictory predictions of global neuronal workspace and integrated information theory. OSF project mbcfy, component wz8mj

prediction.test_for: Prefrontal activity returns to baseline between onset and offset of a lasting conscious stimulus, with no sustained content-specific activity there.
prediction.test_against: Sustained content-specific prefrontal activity for the whole duration of the percept.

study.name: The Cogitate Consortium's adversarial test of global workspace and integrated information theory

source.citation: Cogitate Consortium, Ferrante O, Gorska-Klimowska U, Henin S, et al. Adversarial testing of global neuronal workspace and integrated information theories of consciousness. Nature 642:133-142, 2025

data_collected.basis: The registration was created on OSF on 2019-01-16, and the protocol says the original and amended registrations were frozen before data acquisition began.

passages.text: GNW assumes that all experiences – regardless of their temporal extent – are accompanied by an initial ignition, followed by a decay of signal and maintenance of information in the form of an activity-silent state, with only occasional bursts of reactivation, similar to the concept of silent working memory (Stokes, 2015).

source.citation: Melloni L, Mudrik L, Pitts M, et al. Preregistration file v1, January 2019: Accelerating research on consciousness: an adversarial collaboration to test contradictory predictions of global neuronal workspace and integrated information theory. OSF project mbcfy, component wz8mj

passages.text: The original and the amended preregistration files were frozen prior to the commencement of data acquisition.

source.citation: Melloni L, Mudrik L, Pitts M, Bendtz K, Ferrante O, ... Dehaene S, Koch C, Tononi G, Ward LM. An adversarial collaboration protocol for testing contrasting predictions of global neuronal workspace and integrated information theory. PLOS ONE 18(2):e0268577, 2023
